projects.title: Avunu Odoo Addons
projects.summary: Avunu's Odoo 18 Community modules for email and SMS, document import, AI providers, and the backend and shop-floor UI, built to work alongside OCA.

projects.title: Cloudflare Email Relay
projects.summary: A multi-tenant Cloudflare Email Routing Worker that stores every inbound message and pushes it to the right Odoo or Frappe instance with durable retries.

projects.title: ERPNext TaskView
projects.summary: A project and task workspace for ERPNext, with timers and hour budgets for staff and a portal where customers follow and work on their projects.

projects.title: frappe-nix
projects.summary: Reproducible Nix infrastructure for Frappe and ERPNext, from the development shell to OCI containers and a multi-site NixOS module.

projects.title: Odoo AI Cloudflare Gateway
projects.summary: Adds Cloudflare Workers AI as a MuK AI provider in Odoo 18, optionally routed through a named Cloudflare AI Gateway for usage tracking.

projects.title: Odoo UI and Shop Floor
projects.summary: Odoo 18 modules for a Carbon-styled backend, a live timesheet timer in the navbar, and camera scanning and social sign-in for the OCA Shopfloor app.

projects.title: wordpress-nix
projects.summary: A fast FrankenPHP WordPress stack built with Nix, deployable as OCI containers or a NixOS module, with MySQL, Cloudflare D1, or Turso databases.

projects.title: WP Cloud Files
projects.summary: Stores and serves the WordPress media library from S3-compatible object storage, with direct browser uploads and document thumbnails.
